steps: QP=BA=6; angle C=180-50-70=60 so angle R=60
check_code:
# congruent: P<->A, Q<->B, R<->C
A_,B_=70,50
C_=180-A_-B_
side_QP=6  # = AB
angle={'P':A_,'Q':B_,'R':C_}
opts={'A':(6 if False else None,'R',60),'B':(None,'Q',60),'C':('QP','P',60),'D':('QP','R',60)}
def ok(o):
    side,ang,val=o
    if side=='QP' and side_QP!=6: return False
    if side is None:  # QR = BC unknown, cannot be 6 from given data
        return False
    return angle[ang]==val
good=[k for k,o in opts.items() if ok(o)]
assert good==['D']

import math
a=math.sin(math.radians(31))
res=1/math.tan(math.radians(59))
opts={'A':a/math.sqrt(1-a*a),'B':a/math.sqrt(1+a*a),'C':math.sqrt(1+a*a)/a,'D':math.sqrt(1-a*a)/(2*a)}
assert abs(res-opts['A'])<1e-9
for k in 'BCD': assert abs(res-opts[k])>1e-9

import math
t=math.acos(0.5)
assert abs(1/(1-math.sin(t))+1/(1+math.sin(t))-4/math.cos(t))<1e-9
res=1/math.tan(t)+1/math.sin(t)
opts={'A':math.sqrt(6),'B':math.sqrt(5),'C':math.sqrt(2),'D':math.sqrt(3)}
assert abs(res-opts['D'])<1e-9
for k in 'ABC': assert abs(res-opts[k])>1e-9

import sympy as sp
p=sp.symbols('p')
s3=sp.sqrt(3)
res=sp.solve(sp.Eq(p*(s3+s3),(s3)**3-2*(s3/2)),p)[0]
opts={'A':s3,'B':1,'C':-1,'D':2*s3}
assert res==opts['B']
for k in 'ACD': assert res!=opts[k]
